principle: Reputation is observer-group knowledge, not a universal charisma score.
rules: Different crews, factions or communities can hold different reputations for the same person.
Reputation can be inaccurate when based on incomplete reports or rumor.
Service-record fact and public reputation are separate.
A reputation change requires information propagation, not merely an event occurring somewhere.
AI cannot convert hidden service-record events into public reputation automatically.
